changeSet.author: cashbee
changeSet.comment: Create temporary table with correct platform breakdown aggregated from cashback records joined with affiliate_platform.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE tmp_invoice_cashback AS SELECT pi.id AS invoice_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.order_id) AS correct_total_orders, SUM(c.cashback_amount) AS correct_total_cashback, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'shopee' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_shopee_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'shopee' THEN c.cashback_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_shopee_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'lazada' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_lazada_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'lazada' THEN c.cashback_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_lazada_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'tiki' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_tiki_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'tiki' THEN c.cashback_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_tiki_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'tiktok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_tiktok_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code = 'tiktok' THEN c.cashback_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_tiktok_amount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code NOT IN ('shopee', 'lazada', 'tiki', 'tiktok') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_other_orders, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ap.code NOT IN ('shopee', 'lazada', 'tiki', 'tiktok') THEN c.cashback_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correct_other_amount FROM payment_invoice pi INNER JOIN cashback c ON c.paid_batch_id = pi.batch_id AND c.user_id = pi.user_id INNER JOIN affiliate_platform ap ON ap.id = c.platform_id WHERE c.status = 'PAID' GROUP BY pi.id;

changeSet.author: cashbee
changeSet.comment: Update payment_invoice platform breakdown fields from correct aggregated data. Only updates invoices that have matching cashback records.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE payment_invoice pi INNER JOIN tmp_invoice_cashback t ON t.invoice_id = pi.id SET pi.total_orders = t.correct_total_orders, pi.total_cashback_amount = t.correct_total_cashback, pi.shopee_orders = t.correct_shopee_orders, pi.shopee_amount = t.correct_shopee_amount, pi.lazada_orders = t.correct_lazada_orders, pi.lazada_amount = t.correct_lazada_amount, pi.tiki_orders = t.correct_tiki_orders, pi.tiki_amount = t.correct_tiki_amount, pi.tiktok_orders = t.correct_tiktok_orders, pi.tiktok_amount = t.correct_tiktok_amount, pi.other_orders = t.correct_other_orders, pi.other_amount = t.correct_other_amount, pi.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

changeSet.author: cashbee
changeSet.sql: DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS tmp_invoice_cashback;
